name: Signal Amplifier - Guard
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. It can also enhance an ST's Guard.

61189.name: TacW DMG Reduction II · Guard
61189.SpecificEffects:
When attacked by a Tactical Weapon, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color>.
When performing Guard, Crit RES <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit DMG RES <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
